art_direction: 日向翔阳抱着排球站在安静体育馆，晨光染亮橙发。
composition_variation: Illustrate Shoyo Hinata from Haikyu standing alone in a quiet volleyball gym at sunrise, wearing a plain unlettered black-and-orange practice jersey and shorts. He holds a volleyball comfortably against his hip and smiles with energetic anticipation. Use dynamic but peaceful sports-anime linework, warm orange hair highlights, turquoise floor shadows, and tall windows whose upper panes remain visually quiet. No active match or opponents. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
